verdict.rationale: Docs describe compliance/export APIs (ms-teams-docs-13, ms-teams-docs-14) that can pull channel/chat messages including deleted ones, which could underpin admin search/audit, but there is no documented UI or API for admins to search full message history with sender/channel/date filters as a first-class search feature. Hands-on community reports explicitly contradict any robust search: 'search is abysmal' and 'can't filter Files by type or search within a channel, search results can't be sorted except by date modified' (ms-teams-comm-8, ms-teams-comm-11). Missing for 10: a documented admin search console with sender/channel/date filters, and independent verification that such filtered search actually works reliably.
